response.sql:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_amount
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.average_amount,
       aa.average_amount - oa.average_amount AS excess
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE aa.average_amount > oa.average_amount
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Average across all accounts” means the unweighted average of each account’s average transaction amount; accounts with no transactions are excluded because they have no account average. Transaction amount is averaged as stored, without applying transaction direction.

alternatives.interpretation: If “overall average” means the average amount across all transaction rows, compare each account average to that transaction-weighted average instead.
